result.summary: Found 1 major visual/content issue: a restaurant card displays an invalid delivery price.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data formatting or fallback logic so missing/null delivery fees render as a proper value (e.g., '€0 delivery' or 'Free delivery'), and ensure numeric values are not displayed as NaN.
